topic: Explain how an agent harness handles a customer password-reset request: intake, policy checks, approved tool use, and a safe final response
learning_objective: Understand the step-by-step process an agent follows to securely handle a customer password-reset request, from intake to final response.

scenes.title: Request Intake
scenes.learning_goal: Learn how the agent receives and initially processes a password-reset request.
scenes.example: A customer submits a request saying 'I forgot my password, can you reset it?'

beats.spoken_text: The agent receives the customer's password-reset request through a secure channel like email or a support portal.
The agent logs the request in the system, noting the customer's identity and the time of the request.

scenes.bridge_to_next: Once the request is logged, the agent moves to verify the customer's identity.

scenes.title: Identity Verification
scenes.learning_goal: Understand the policy checks the agent performs to verify the customer's identity before proceeding.
scenes.example: The agent asks for the customer's registered email or security questions.

beats.spoken_text: The agent checks the customer's identity by asking for pre-registered information like an email address or answers to security questions.
If the provided information matches the records, the agent proceeds. If not, the request is flagged as suspicious.

scenes.bridge_to_next: With identity confirmed, the agent can now use the password-reset tool.

scenes.title: Password Reset Tool
scenes.learning_goal: Learn how the agent uses the approved tool to reset the password securely.
scenes.example: The agent accesses the admin panel to generate a temporary password.

beats.spoken_text: The agent accesses the company's approved password-reset tool, which generates a temporary password or a reset link.
The tool ensures the new password meets security standards, like minimum length and complexity.

scenes.bridge_to_next: After generating the new credentials, the agent delivers them to the customer.

scenes.title: Secure Delivery
scenes.learning_goal: Understand how the agent safely communicates the new credentials to the customer.
scenes.example: The agent sends the temporary password via a secure method like encrypted email.

beats.spoken_text: The agent sends the temporary password or reset link to the customer through a secure method, such as encrypted email or a secure portal.
The agent instructs the customer to change the temporary password immediately after logging in.

scenes.bridge_to_next: This concludes the secure handling of a password-reset request.
